value.rationale: Mass-resolved orbit census and sharp energy windows are natural objects in parallel chip-firing, especially on the mean-field complete graph underlying the known devil staircase. The result resolves every achievable mass for primitive period three and counts states at the previously excluded endpoints exactly, rather than merely inferring a routine special case of the known period bound. The coefficient polynomial is a complete natural classification with explicit orbit counts and no arbitrary parameter slice.
